# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He habitually twirls his mustache while in the classroom.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Pidgeon is an ineffective teacher who maintains poor discipline in his classroom. He frequently neglects his general teaching duties to focus on older pupils, particularly Sukey Pullen, whom he openly pursues with romantic notes, poetry, and attention. He also employs a mocking tone with his students when administering discipline, though he is willing to admit his own fault when a student is unfairly blamed for a disturbance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley school, securing the position largely due to the influence of his uncle, who was a school trustee. During his tenure, he focused much of his attention on preparing older students for the Regent's Academy entrance exam and courting Sukey Pullen. His favoritism toward Sukey and poor classroom discipline drew criticism from locals, and he frequently punished students unjustly or through public humiliation. During a notable classroom incident, he mocked Nell Harcourt, prompting her to smash her slate over Hugh Carrow's head; although Hugh took the blame, Pidgeon forced Nell to stand on a dais beneath a harsh inscription on the blackboard. On another occasion, he made Nell sit next to Hugh Carrow as a punishment for being late. Aside from his teaching, Pidgeon participated in local events, delivering a speech at a Brierley Debating Club concert and reciting Mark Antony's address over Caesar's body. At the end of the school year, he delivered a moving farewell speech to the students before resigning his position, which was subsequently taken over by a female teacher, Miss Agnes Thorne.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c22 P8](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0008)_
